nodes.label: Minima Core launcher icon (mdpi): green rounded-square tile with a subtle lighter-green grid/mesh pattern background and a dark-teal Android robot head silhouette (two antennae, two eyes) centered on it. This is a stock/template Android-robot launcher icon rather than bespoke Minima branding — it identifies the org.minimarex.minimacore node app on the home screen at mdpi density but carries generic Android platform imagery, suggesting placeholder branding for the base/core APK.

Android robot head mark: the well-known Android mascot silhouette (rounded head with two antennae and two eyes) as rendered inside the launcher icon, indicating use of default/template Android branding imagery.
